protocol.framing: Supplied SepsisLabel, restricted to hours strictly before label-implied onset; first-row-positive and uncertain-transition records excluded
protocol.training_sampling: uniform without replacement across eligible training hours, seed fixed before fitting; same rows for all models
protocol.calibration: sigmoid of clipped raw-probability logit, separately fit for each model on validation/calibration

alternative_thresholds.primary_research_threshold: maximum F1 on validation/threshold, highest threshold resolves ties

training.dataset: PhysioNet Challenge 2019 v1.0.0 training sets A+B
training.weighting: Each eligible observed hour has equal evaluation weight; hours are correlated within patients
training.framing: Supplied SepsisLabel on pre-onset hours only, six-hour label-implied onset framing; uncertain onsets excluded

context.dataset: PhysioNet Challenge 2019 v1.0.0 training sets A+B
context.weighting: Each eligible observed hour has equal evaluation weight; hours are correlated within patients
context.framing: Supplied SepsisLabel on pre-onset hours only, six-hour label-implied onset framing; uncertain onsets excluded

watch.interpretation: When clinical-history availability is supplied, empty prefixes cannot alert. Retrospective label-implied onset; conditional lead-time summaries omit misses. Window detections are experimental, not proof of clinical usefulness. No cooldown; repeated hourly alerts counted for burden.

inference_coverage.policy: Model discrimination uses all eligible hours. The inference interface withholds empty clinical prefixes; lead-time alerts below apply that same withholding policy.

qsofa_2_component_proxy.availability_policy: All required current values must be observed and within documented mechanical bounds; no carry or imputation.
qsofa_2_component_proxy.interpretation: Incomplete score versus model on identical complete-case hours; retrospective discrimination is not clinical validation.
